bundle.shortDescription: Voice production studio for audiobooks, games, podcasts, and dictation
bundle.longDescription: JustVoice — an open-source voice production studio. Audiobook production with ACX-compliant mastering, game-dialogue export, podcast assembly, dictation, and accessibility. Renders through Kokoro, Qwen3-TTS, Chatterbox, LuxTTS, TADA, Dia, and MOSS-TTSD engines.
